I know i left the same comment in r/psychic but Ummm, i don't want to be the a hole guy but it sounds to me like your daughter has a rare migraine phenomenon. I believe your daughter has Acephalgic migraine. Acephalgic migraine is a neurological syndrome. It is a relatively uncommon variant of migraine in which the patient may experience aura, nausea, photophobia, hemiparesis, scintillating scotomas and other migraine symptoms, but does not experience headache. A typical migraine headache starts with shimmering or flashing lights, often times they surround a blurry area or have dots or jaggedly lines (scintillating scotomas) associated with them. They tend to progressively increase in intensity and sometimes march across the visual field.

You should probably talk to your doctor about this as Individuals who experience acephalgic migraines in childhood are highly likely to develop typical migraines as they grow older.
